raw_line: 6,[A low-angle wide shot captures the skeletal remains of a once-massive skyscraper, its glass facade shattered and dark against a twilight sky, as the camera slowly dollies forward along a debris-strewn street],[The cobblestones are littered with the rusted husks of abandoned electric vehicles and scattered circuit boards, their metallic surfaces reflecting the faint, amber glow of the dying sun],[Soft wind whistles through the broken windows, carrying the distant, muffled sound of rustling leaves that are beginning to sprout from the cracks in the pavement],[A small, dark-feathered bird hops silently into the frame from the left edge, landing delicately on a cracked concrete slab],[The camera tilts down slightly to follow the bird as it pecks curiously at a discarded smartphone screen lying face-up, its cracked display flickering with a single dying pixel],[As the bird pauses, the camera executes a slow pan to the right, revealing more patches of vibrant green moss and young saplings pushing through the asphalt, signaling nature's slow reclamation of the silent, futuristic city]
segments: A low-angle wide shot captures the skeletal remains of a once-massive skyscraper, its glass facade shattered and dark against a twilight sky, as the camera slowly dollies forward along a debris-strewn street
The cobblestones are littered with the rusted husks of abandoned electric vehicles and scattered circuit boards, their metallic surfaces reflecting the faint, amber glow of the dying sun
Soft wind whistles through the broken windows, carrying the distant, muffled sound of rustling leaves that are beginning to sprout from the cracks in the pavement
A small, dark-feathered bird hops silently into the frame from the left edge, landing delicately on a cracked concrete slab
segments_zh: 低角度广角镜头捕捉到了一座曾经巨大的摩天大楼的骨架残骸，其玻璃幕墙破碎，在暮色天空的映衬下一片漆黑，摄影机沿着一条布满碎片的街道缓慢前行。
鹅卵石上散落着废弃电动汽车生锈的外壳和散落的电路板，它们的金属表面反射着垂死太阳的微弱琥珀色光芒
柔和的风从破碎的窗户吹过，远处传来低沉的沙沙声，树叶开始从人行道的裂缝中发芽。
A small, dark-feathered bird hops silently into the frame from the left edge, landing delicately on a cracked concrete slab
